definitions.cornering_fraction: fraction of live-player ticks with min(x, y, W-x, H-y) <= 2.0 m AND >=1 alive MELEE body within its engine reach; melee = reach <= 3.0 m off g5_header.g5.commit_reach.by_attacker_m
definitions.cornering_fraction_any_reach: same, but ANY body incl. the 18.5 m Evocator
definitions.min_hp_fraction: min over ticks of tick.entities[player].hp / max_hp

pick_rule: argmin(min_hp_fraction) among cornering_fraction == 0; if every fight corners -> argmin(cornering_fraction); if no uncornered fight dips below 0.75 min-HP -> argmax(intake_pool_fraction) among the uncornered
notes: Primary rule: argmin(min_hp_fraction) among cornering_fraction == 0. 60 of 200 fights are uncornered; 4 of those dip below 0.75 min-HP.
